summary: Slack AI offers channel summaries, search answers, and thread recaps. It is a paid add-on that must be purchased and enabled by workspace admins. If your workspace has it, admins can disable it from settings. Individual members cannot toggle it — it is controlled at the org level.

steps.path: Workspace admin: Settings & administration → Settings → AI → toggle off 'Slack AI'
If not an admin: there is no individual opt-out. Ask your admin to disable it or limit which channels it can access.

collateral: only available on paid Slack plans — free workspaces do not have Slack AI
admins can restrict AI to specific channels rather than disabling entirely
whyTheyDidIt: Salesforce is monetizing AI as a premium add-on per seat.

alternatives.name: Zulip
alternatives.why: open-source team chat, no AI features forced in
